index.chunk: Chunks follow tree-sitter declarations instead of fixed-size windows, because windows cut functions in half and duplicate context. Cost: only Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, Java and C/C++ have grammars, so other source languages are not indexed.
index.embed: A local INT8 ONNX embedding model on the CPU instead of a hosted embedding API, because code never leaves the machine. Cost: a 137 MB model download, and queries take 0.9 to 1.8 s since each one starts the process and loads the model.
disk.vectors: An append-only log with tombstones plus a hand-written HNSW graph instead of a database, because updates never rewrite the file and a crash leaves only a torn tail, repaired on load. Cost: dead records stay on disk until they outnumber live ones.
fuse: Reciprocal Rank Fusion instead of adding raw scores, because cosine similarity and BM25 sit on incompatible scales. Cost: only ranks are used, so a far stronger match gets no more weight than a marginally stronger one.
